timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: GOOD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: 1413 KRW/USD

WHY: The won has strengthened significantly to 1413 KRW/USD, described as a "10-month low" and representing a major improvement from the "1550원의 공포" (1550 fear level). Multiple sources indicate the won is near recent strength, with analyst commentary suggesting further strengthening toward the 1300s is possible, meaning your $2,000 monthly cost in KRW is currently cheaper than it has been in months.

TIP: Lock in this strong won rate for your monthly conversion now, as timing a fixed dollar obligation becomes easier when the won is at multi-month strength—further gains are uncertain and you may face weaker rates again soon.
